name: Sonnet, English
note: Three quatrains that can each hold a different angle on the same thing, and a couplet that has to pay for all three. The couplet is the danger: it is short enough to be glib and positioned to sound like a verdict.
ground: Surrey and Wyatt brought the Italian sonnet into English and found that English does not have enough rhyme-words to run four on one sound. The English form is a workaround for a shortage in the language, and it produced a different instrument: seven rhyme sounds instead of four or five, and a turn that can be delayed to the last two lines.
ask: Where is your turn, and did you put it at nine because the form says so?
